business_domain: financial services; zero-trust access to transaction systems
organization_goal: protect customer transactions against unauthorized access and change

kpis.text: Requests authenticated and authorized per request

tasks: Authenticate each request against the identity provider
Evaluate access policy per request (role, device, context)
Require step-up authentication for privileged actions
beliefs: No network location is trusted by default

kpis.text: Changes to posted records approved by a second person
Changes logged with user, time, and reason

tasks: Route changes to posted records for approval
Write an immutable audit log entry for each change
constraints: Audit logs cannot be edited or deleted

contribution_values.element: Require step-up authentication for privileged actions

rational_statements.text: Per-request verification removes the implicit trust that let compromised sessions move laterally.

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: per-request policy checks added latency to teller screens
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: cache policy decisions for 5 minutes for non-privileged reads; privileged actions always re-verified
